study.name: Secondhand strategic-missingness audit
study.primary: Original 1000-record prefixes and declared .1 capacity; full real cohorts are sensitivity
study.holdout: Validation cohorts previously examined; original test labels not used

units.listing_rows: Repeated per seed and method, not independent samples
units.evaluation_clusters: shared hash-ordered batches across methods and fitting seeds; tail weighted by listing count
units.source_units: MAE uses source currency, not pooled currency

response.guarantee: finite unilateral tolerance at returned peers only

outcomes.name: inflation
outcomes.definition: mean positive expected quote minus frozen truthful quote

outcomes.name: honest_mae
outcomes.definition: mean absolute truthful price prediction error

outcomes.name: attacked_mae
outcomes.definition: expected absolute attacked error over verification randomization

outcomes.name: net_deviation
outcomes.definition: positive best legal unilateral utility minus truthful utility; not returned net gain

outcomes.name: regret
outcomes.definition: best legal unilateral utility minus returned utility

inference.simultaneous: Posthoc 36/108/1536-family sensitivities; no finite-sample FWER certificate
inference.variance: Exact conditional weighted bootstrap main/interaction variance, not new training-population variance
inference.thresholds: Inherited 10% inflation / 5% honest error gate; grid sensitivity retained

independent_components: separate bit-mask state enumeration and transitions
algebraic allocation and all legal unilateral utilities
audit_scope.limits: No from-scratch independent predictor implementation; no global joint equilibrium certificate

release.available: Private GitHub small artifacts and hash-bound aggregate archives; models/raw listings remain on original machine
